Container.Name: seadex-scout
Container.Overview: Compares your Sonarr and Radarr anime library with SeaDex (seadex.moe), the community list of the best release for each show, and shows where a better release exists. This fork has its own web dashboard on port 9119: upgrades available, a library overview, the scout's health and on-demand reports, with no Grafana, Loki or Alertmanager needed. It never downloads anything; Sonarr and Radarr stay in charge.
Container.Requires: A Sonarr instance, a Radarr instance or both, with anime in them.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: The built-in web dashboard.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml, saved state, the dashboard's state and the reports folder.

Config.Name: Sonarr URL
Config.Description: The address you open Sonarr at from another device, such as http://192.168.1.10:8989. Not localhost. Leave empty to turn Sonarr off.

Config.Name: Sonarr API key
Config.Description: Sonarr, Settings, General, API Key.

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address you open Radarr at, such as http://192.168.1.10:7878.

Config.Name: Radarr API key
Config.Description: Radarr, Settings, General, API Key.

Config.Name: Dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional. Set it to require a sign-in (user name below) for the dashboard. Empty leaves the dashboard open to your network.

Config.Name: Dashboard user name
Config.Description: The user name for the dashboard sign-in, used only when a password is set.

Config.Name: Dashboard listen port
Config.Description: The port the dashboard listens on inside the container. Set to off to turn the dashboard off. If you change it, change the container port above too.

Config.Name: ntfy topic URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your ntfy topic's full address, such as https://ntfy.sh/my-seadex-topic, to get a message for each new upgrade and each problem. Pick a long, hard-to-guess topic name on the public server.

Config.Name: ntfy access token
Config.Description: Optional. An ntfy access token (tk_...) for a protected topic.

Config.Name: ntfy user name
Config.Description: Optional. For a protected topic, instead of a token.

Config.Name: ntfy password
Config.Description: Optional. For a protected topic, instead of a token.

Config.Name: ntfy events
Config.Description: What to send, comma-separated: upgrades (new upgrades and newer versions), problems (SeaDex down, stalled checks and so on, and when they end), errors (at most once per error every 6 hours), reports (a report you started finished).

Config.Name: ntfy optional upgrades
Config.Description: true also sends upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt.

Config.Name: ntfy unmonitored
Config.Description: true also sends upgrades for unmonitored series, seasons and movies.

Config.Name: Dashboard address
Config.Description: Optional. The address you open the dashboard at, such as http://192.168.1.10:9119/, for a Dashboard button on each notification.

Config.Name: Indexer port
Config.Description: Optional Torznab indexer for Sonarr and Radarr. Used only after you fill in the indexer section of config.yaml.

Config.Name: Indexer feed key
Config.Description: Optional, for the indexer. See docs/torznab-indexer.md.

Config.Name: Prowlarr API key
Config.Description: Optional, for the indexer.

Config.Name: AnimeBytes passkey
Config.Description: Optional, for the indexer's AnimeBytes releases.
